annotations.title: Look up an AI company by name

description: Resolve an already named AI company by name or alias, then read get_company with its returned ID. The default company_name mode also accepts concise literal capability keywords for broader unranked candidates; such matches do not prove industry fit. For a business problem or a new vendor shortlist, use find_ai_companies. Existing callers can still use intent business_need here with a full English workflow; it returns the same task-scoped company candidates as find_ai_companies. Preserve coverage gaps and unknown facts.

intent.description: Use business_need for a full English problem/workflow when finding new providers. company_name preserves existing exact-name/alias or concise literal capability-keyword lookup.

limit.description: Requested number of individual result rows (1–50): top 2 corresponds to limit 2. Also the page size for continuation requests.

query.description: With business_need: the full English problem, desired work, industry and constraints, preserving all channels and phone/booking requirements. Translate other languages without dropping requirements. With company_name: an exact known name/alias, or concise literal capability keywords for unranked text matches.

name: search_companies
